report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is supported; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or traces showing failing checkout requests (order/gateway logs were excluded)
Metrics or traces capturing non-200 checkout responses during the incident window
Deployment history showing a version change preceding any observed error onset
